batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b RJ Harris

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c HH Gibbs b RJ Harris

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b RP Singh

batting.name: R Bhatia
batting.dismissal: c Y Venugopal Rao b RP Singh

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c DP Nannes b A Mishra

batting.name: AA Bilakhia
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b A Mishra

batting.name: A Symonds
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b A Mishra

balls.text: another swing and a miss and the ball just sneaks past the legstump, they try to streal another bye but Gilchrist's accurate with the underarm lob to the stumps
hoicks him over square leg and they risk the second run, Suman fires a fast and flat throw from the deep and Dilshan was always struggling
makes room and misses and they steal the bye, Gilchrist underarms the ball to the bowler's end and the batsman just makes it
pitches it up outside off and Bhatia makes room to slice it past backward point but he ends up spooning it straight to Rao in that position
pitches it up on middle and leg and he hoicks him over square leg, the ball just beats the boundary rider
plenty of improvisation! He shapes to play the switch hit but he miscues the shot and the ball drops at cover just wide of the fielder
this is a genuine wide, too wide outside off and Dilshan couldn't fetch it
through the gate! Harris fires a yorker on the base of the off and middle stumps and Karthik exposes the woodwork as he shapes to slash it square on the off side, the bails go flying
makes room and crashes a full delivery past the covers but Suman's there in the deep to cut it off
makes room and he fails to slap a length delivery, he doesn't ride the bounce there
squeezed out to the covers and Rohit's throw is just wide of the stumps at the bowler's end, a direct hit would have sent him back
the bouncer and Karthik connects well with the hook,  seemed like a mis-hit at first but there was enough elevation to clear long leg
just a touch too wide outside off, Karthik has a desperate swish at it but the movement beats him
starts off with a bouncer and that climbs over his helmet as he tries to hook
keeps it short and Karthik gets his elbows high and forces it to sweeper cover, just three off the over, good one
angles it across him and wide and Karthik moves across his stumps to hoick him but only meets thin air
makes a bit of room but he can only place it straight to deep cover, they need to find the gaps here
stands tall and punches him down to Rao at sweeper cover
moves right across his stumps and tries to slash but the ball keeps low and beats the edge
the bowling change works! He pitches it slightly short of a length and AB clears his front leg and tries to pull him but the ball kicks up a bit more and catches the outside edge
full on the leg stump and clipped to deep midwicket
gives it a lot of air on middle and leg  and AB clears his front leg and slams it high over wide long-on, this over is hurting  Deccan
gets on the front foot and drives to long-off
and it brings him luck, Good Lord Gibbs has dropped it, Dilshan comes down the pitch and hoicks a full toss and Gibbs drops a fairly easy take at deep midwicket
gets on his knee and swings him hard along the turf to wide long-on
full on middle and off and he works it to the on side
poor call! The ball actually clips his pads and rolls to the keeper as he tries to sweep
makes room and cuts him hard to wide mid-off
comes down the track and drives him to long-on
flat and maximum! He gets on his knee and clubs him over deep midwicket, the ball travelled like a rocket, nobody moved
makes room and pushes a full delivery down to deep extra cover
gets on his knee and sweeps him down to deep square-leg
very slow through the air, he waits for it before steering it softly with the turn to point, they scamper through for the single
clips it towards the on side, Deccan have really pulled things back in these last five overs
pushed back towards the bowler
flicks it towards deep square-leg and Rao has a bit of ground to cover to cut that off
turns it towards fine leg
chips down the track and clips a low full toss to deep midwicket
length delivery, he turns it to deep midwicket
he clips a full toss on the legstump to deep square leg
works it to the on side for a single
that's his fifty! He makes room and crashes him on the front foot square of the wicket on the off side, there's nobody patrolling the area
fires the yorker and he squeezes it out to long-on
he chips it to extra cover for a quick single
plays an on drive to long-on
works it behind square on the on side for a single
gets to the pitch of the ball and drives to cover
flighted on leg and worked behind square on the on side
comes down the track and lofts it to right of Symonds at long-on
cuts it to short third man and an overthrow results in an extra run
digs out a yorker back to the bowler
drives on the up to short mid-off
Harmeet fluffs a chance to get rid of AB! The bowler misfield and AB thinks of running off that misfield but darts back to his crease, Harmeet fails to fire the throw in time to the stumps
strays on the pads and he clips it down to fine leg
forces a full delivery straight to mid-off
gete behind the line and taps it down to mid-off
kicks up off a good length and AB gets a wake up call as he just manages to withdraw his bat

Sehwag pays the price for getting too far across, he exposes the middle and leg stumps as he tries to paddle it away to fine leg, the ball clips his thigh right in front and the umpire doesn't take too long to decide
gets half forward and punches him hard to covers
stays at the crease and clips him hard to long-on
keeps a bit low and the ball stops on Sehwag as he tries to clip it away, he ends up getting a thick inside edge and the ball nearly rolls onto his stumps
swivels and pulls off the front foot to deep square leg
very streaky boundary for Delhi, Sehwag swings and misses and the ball beats Gilchrist down the leg side, don't ask me how that missed the leg stump
pushes it past the big gap between point and cover
bowls it stump to stump and he gets beside the line and chops it down to point, he tells his partner to stay back
clips it across the line past the vacant spaces at square leg
strays on the pads and he clips it behind square on the on side
goes for the slog but mistimes the ball to the on side
stays back and clips him hard past midwicket, they take the first run quickly
overpitches outside off and he clears the front leg and crashes it with full force past the covers
Dropped Dilshan gets a thick outside edge on the cut and the ball strikes Gilchrist's gloves and drops down
slaps it hard to the off side but he finds point, Symonds should be careful with that line
flighted on leg and he pushes it down towards mid-on
cut towards Rohit at point for a single
flighted on the pads and he clips it off his pads
cuts back on the pace and Sehwag has enough time to chip down and loft him hard inside out over extra cover
makes room and pushes it wide of cover
gives him the charge and makes room but checks the loft, the ball dips and lands well in front of Symonds at long-off
that's another Dilshan slap, Symonds errs by giving him width and he forces it just wide of the diving point fielder
skids through and clips his pads as he tries to work it away
angles it on the pads and he clips it towards midwicket
takes the aerial route again but he keeps it down as he chips it down to mid-on
he gives it a bit more bounce and Sehwag waits for it to come on before lofting him over the covers
keeps a little low and he plays a short arm pull to the on side
this one bounces a lot more and beats the edge as he tries to slash him away
I spoke too soon, he flights it outside off and lands it full, he chases it rolls his wrists and cracks it just wide of the diving fielder at point
makes a bit of room and slaps it hard to point, he can't bisect that field
stays back and chops a wide delivery straight to Rao at cover
slow through the air and he chips down the track and crashes it past the bowler and mid-off, all power
flighted outside off and driven to the covers
turns his wrists and clips it just wide of square leg
stays at the crease and pushes it hard to the on side
tries to go downtown but he mistimes the loft over midwicket, the ball drops in the middle of nowhere
nips back in off the pitch and he mistimes the flick to mid-on
Free Hit Full and wide and Sehwag crashes it straight to point
oversteps and Sehwag gets a leading edge which balloons over point
he flashes hard at a wide delivery and beats the diving backward point fielder, third man is square enough to cut it off
precision from Sehwag, he gets forward and forces a length delivery past the gap between mid-off and cover, nice full swing of the bat
the bouncer isn't good enough for the umpire, Sehwag ducks and safely gets out of the way
chases another wide one but he gets a thick outside edge which beats the keeper and runs to third man
chases a wide delivery but there's no timing at all as the ball drops somewhere in front of him
kicks up off a good length and he decides to let it go to the keeper
forces it away hard with a front foot drive but he fails to beat cover
gives him width outside off and Dikshan rolls his wrists and cuts him hard square of the wicket between backward point and cover
short and wide, you can't bowl it to Sehwag there because he will just cream you over backward point and that's exactly what he did
lets go of the bouncer and nearly hangs out that periscope
punches it on the up but places it wide of mid-off
take that for a response! He gets a fraction forward to a full ball and crashes it past the bowler, mid-off barely had time to blink
almost a hat-trick for the team! Sehwag clips it to mid-off, calls for the run, sends him back, Dilshan struggles to make his ground and Harris fails to collect the throw cleanly from Rao
he gives him a hint of room outside off and Dilshan controls his glide to third man by keeping the ball down, the ball bisects the gap between slip and gully
Streaky six! RP bangs it in short and towards the helmet, Dilshan hooks it down to long leg and Harris tries to catch it one handed but the ball sails over, he was perhaps well in front of the rope
hops at the crease and steers it to Rao who dives at cover
angles it on the middle stump and he taps it down to the off side
pitches it up outside off and Sehwag scoops it over the covers, two fielders chase and Symonds pulls it back just before the rope and relays it to Gibbs, excellent fielding
he gets beside the line and steers it to point

two in two! Harris is the man of the moment, he bowls it a touch wide outside off and invites the slash, Warner obliges but chops it straight to Gibbs at backward point, Harris will be on a hat-trick the next over

Gambhir chips down the track and bash it over the off side, he makes room and Harris makes him chase the ball by bowling it wide,the ball flies off the top half off the bat and sails into RP's palms at third man
lands it outside off and the ball shapes across, no shot offered
tucks him up with a short one and after fending it away the ball dribbles close to the stumps
he pokes his bat out half heartedly at a ball which swings away and nearly edges it
gets good bounce and carry straightway, leaves it alone to Gilchrist
squeezes a yorker to third man and it's all over!
some late drama to spice things up, he pushes it to Bhatia at midwicket for a single but he's sent back, a direct hit would have sent him back
swish and a miss, not quite Rohit's night, a quiet single will do it, Sir
drops it short and he gets on top of the bounce by making room, an upper cut to the third man yields a single
tries to finish it off with one hoick but he mistimes it to square leg, Gambhir has a shy at the stumps but the throw is wide
clips it wide of mid-on and sets off
moves across the stumps, he comes down the pitch to hoick it away but misses
The bouncer doesn't really come off well and Rohit ducks and lets it go
pacy delivery outside off and he defends back to the bowler with a straight bat
swing and a miss, nowhere near the bounce
Nannes returns, Suman opens the face of the bat and glides it with control down to third man
shuffles and clips it wide of midwicket
holds the length back outside off and the extra bounce catches him by surprise and beats the bat as he shapes to punch
fires it fuller and he digs it out to mid-off
gets beside the line and he steers him down to point
goes for another one-legged pull, the ball rolls to short fine leg
pulls him on one leg but he mistimes it to square leg
forget the singles, it's a friendly half volley outside off and with the field up you have to expect a boundary, he bisects the gap perfectly between mid-off and cover
angles it on the body and he shuffles and clips it to deep square leg, they can do this in singles
comes round the wicket, he opens the face of the bat and steers him wide of backward point
clips it past the vacant midwicket region and they take the second easily this time
taps it with soft hands to point
clips it towards square leg and Nehra comes charging in from fine leg, they decide against the couple
Karthik and Mishra appeal half-heartedly for a bat pad catch, Suman tries to clip him to the on side
shuffles and clips him to the on side
he tries to go downtown again, Symonds stays at the crease, fails to get the elevation and the ball dips to Warner at long-on
Symonds decides to take him on and he connects, he kneels down and slogs him against the turn, the ball clears deep midwicket, not the most attractive slog
extra bounce and it beats Symonds, careful!
spins away and beats Symonds' hopeful prod
steers it with soft hands towards cover and retains the strike
gets beside the line and taps it towards mid-off
drops it towards the off side and he tells his partner to wait
back to back and this one goes the other side, Nehra drops it short on the helmet and he swivels and works it on its way to fine leg, just a gentle touch
cheeky and well, there was nothing anybody could do about it, he opens the face very late and gets a safe outside edge past the keeper, third man was too square
fullish on the pads and he works it wide of midwicket
gets forward and pushes a full delivery to long-off
defends with a dead bat, very very rare sight that
works a full delivery against the turn to long-on
comes down the pitch and checks his shot, defends and trudges back to his crease
stays at the crease and plays a short arm pull to fine leg
gets across his stumps early and paddles it against the turn to fine leg
gets beside the line, drops the ball in front of cover and takes an easy single
shuffles and clips him to midwicket
he drops it short and wide outside off, he upper cuts it down to third man
that's an ugly hoick but Symonds won't mind! He makes a bit off room and enjoys a slog and the ball just drops in front of the rope at deep midwicket
didn't take too long to get his eye in! He makes room,clears his front leg and scoops a pitched up delivery over extra cover
action straight away, he covers his stumps and drops the ball towards cover and sets off, he scampers to the other end and AB's throw strikes Symonds' back but they take the overthrow

just at the stroke of the strategy break! Is there a twist here? Gilchrist charges down the track to hit with the turn but he messes up the loft, fails to get to the pitcj of the ball and the top edge swirls in the air to the off side, Nannes sprints from short third man and falls forward as he takes the catch
skids on the pads and he clips it hard to midwicket
shuffles and clips it against the turn to square leg
stays at the crease and pushes it back to the bowler
drops it short on seeing him advance and he checks his shot and cuts to point
chips down the track and takes the aerial route, not well timed but safe of Warner at long-on who nearly over runs the ball
pushed back to the bowler
pushes it through the line to long-off
slow through the air but flat, he kneels down well in time to slog him cleanly over square leg, he's on overdrive tonight
forces it just wide of Dilshan's right and the ball rolls to long-on
clips him softly straight to Sehwag at square leg
gets forward and punches him hard wide of short cover
Bilakhia gets adventurous by chipping down the track but he fails to read the googly and swings all around it, easy stumping for Karthik
doesn't pick the fast googly, he nearly gets an inside edge onto the stumps
fires it flat and quick and he slaps it wide of cover
uses his feet and pushes him just wide of the bowler
gives it a lot of air and Bilakhia smothers the spin
shuffles and clips him behind square on the onside and he sets off very quickly
gets right across his stumps and paddles him to fine leg
fires it full and flat, he pushes it wide of the bowler
waits for the ball and dabs it to point
and he quietly gets off the strike by pushing him to long-on
works it back to the bowler
flighted on leg, he works it to the on side
he goes for another hoick but gets a lucky inside edge which beats the stumps, Sehwag reaches out for his cap and forgets there's an extra ball
Guys this show's not over! he chips down the track and takes him downtown, over the sightscreen this time
flighted outside off and Gilchrist takes another stroll down the track and lofts him with the turn to wide long-off
Free Hit And Sehwag dishes out a high full toss, Christmas has come early for this man, he clubs him over wide long-on
the overstep bug bites Sehwag as well, Gilchrist takes a couple of paces down and bisects the gap between mid-off and cover
pushed down the pitch back to the bowler, he fumbles
pushes a full delivery through the line to long-on
fires it quick and the ball skids through and beats the edge as he shapes to cut
quicker delivery on the pads and he clips it down to square leg
prods forward and the ball straightens and beats him
that's the IPL record for the fastest fifty! he makes room and chops it wide of cover point, the previous record was jointly held by McCullum and Yusuf Pathan
stays back and slams it hard back to the bowler
he fires a yorker on the legstump and h squeezes it out to deep midwicket
Free Hit The attempted yorker turns into a low full toss and he has a free swing of the bat and fetches a six over the sight screen
he oversteps and there's further insult, half volley outside off and Gilchrist crashes it past mid-off who falls to his right in vain
sweet sound of bat on ball as he pulls but he doesn't control it well, there's enough elevation to clear square leg, there's protection in the deep
gets behind the line and pushes it just wide of cover to get off the strike
stays behind the line and taps it to mid-off
quick bouncer and Bilakhia's reflexes aren't sharp enough to hook it away, he makes an attempt though
shapes to drive but gets a thick inside edge which rolls towards the keeper
slides down the leg side and wide called, even Sangwan's having a nightmare
he gets width to drive but he fails to make contact
it's a low full toss and he spares the bowler by clipping it down to long-on
forget about it! That;s gone about 20 rows back, the ball is well pitched up and he swings him across the line and plants it over deep midwicket, take cover!
not his best shot so far but he won't bother, he clobbers him across the line and the ball just beats square leg
sorry, Gilchrist isn't sparing him either, he bowls it slightly short but very wide, enough width for him to free his arms and slap it past the gap between mid-off and cover
squeezes a full delivery in front of mid-off and sets off quickly, the throw is just wide of the stumps but the batsmen are safe
shapes to cut but he checks his shot and the outside edge flies to third man
fuller in length and on the offstump, he taps it towards cover
gets behind the line and steers it to point

timber! Now Delhi can smile again, Gibbs goes hell for leather by chipping down the track but he swings blindly and fails to make any contact whatsoever, the ball crashes onto middle and off and Nehra gives him a send-off of sorts
shuffles and clips him straight to square leg
drops it too wide outside off, Delhi are in a state of shock here
what does poor Nannes do? He pitches it up on middle and leg and a mere defensive push through the line is enough to beat the bowler and mid-on, Gilly wants to get to Jo'burg fast
take that! He pitches it up outside off and he gets behind the line and pushes it past the gap between mid-off and cover, no power, all timing
there;s no stopping him, he bangs it in short outside off and he gets on top of the bounce and slashes him over backward point
he overcompensates by overpitching outside off and Gilchrist pushes at it hard and beats the bowler, forget about chasing it
bangs it in a fraction too short and Gilchrist swivels, gets on top of the bounce and pulls him along the turf to deep square-leg
that's a quick bouncer, fizzes over Gilchrist
pacy delivery on the offstump, he gets beside the line and steers it to point
